The public XLarge spelling maps explicitly to native X-Large; capacities and minute-based build meaning agree. A default scalar of one cannot certify candidate/input-meaning parity.
rows.limitation: Resolve the service billing meaning against current source-of-truth specifications and mapping contract. Do not silently reinterpret saved public GWLB counts or assert a monthly price difference from physically unequal quantities. Public missing AmazonVPC price-source errors are recorded in separate runtime failures.
